### `create_folder`

**Create Folder** · `POST /api/v2/space/{space_id}/folder` · API v2 · 🟡 write

Add a new Folder to a Space. You can optionally create the Folder as a subfolder within an existing Folder by providing `parent_folder_id` in the request body. Subfolder support must be enabled for the Workspace.

| Argument | In | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `space_id` | path | number | yes |  |
| `body` | body | object | yes | JSON request body, fields below. |

<details>
<summary><code>body</code> fields (2)</summary>

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `name` | string | yes |  |
| `parent_folder_id` | string |  | ID of an existing Folder to create this Folder inside of as a subfolder. The parent Folder must belong to the same Space specified in the path. Subfolder support must be enabled for the Workspace. |

</details>

### `create_folder_from_template`

**Create Folder from template** · `POST /api/v2/space/{space_id}/folder_template/{template_id}` · API v2 · 🟡 write

Create a new Folder using a Folder template within a Space. This endpoint allows you to create a folder with all its nested assets (lists, tasks, etc.) from a predefined template available in your Workspace. Publicly shared templates must be [added to your Workspace](https://help.clickup.com/hc/en-us/articles/6326023965591-Add-a-template-to-your-library) before you can use them with the public API.
You can optionally create the Folder as a subfolder within an existing Folder by providing `parent_folder_id` in the request body. Subfolder support must be enabled for the Workspace.
This request can be run asynchronously or synchronously via the `return_immediately` parameter.

| Argument | In | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `space_id` | path | string | yes | ID of the Space where the Folder will be created |
| `template_id` | path | string | yes | ID of the Folder template to use. Template IDs include a `t-` prefix (e.g., `t-7162342`). Retrieve available template IDs using the [Get Folder Templates](templates.md#get_folder_templates) endpoint. |
| `body` | body | object | yes | JSON request body, fields below. |

### `get_folder`

**Get Folder** · `GET /api/v2/folder/{folder_id}` · API v2 · 🟢 read-only

View the Lists within a Folder. If the Folder is a subfolder, the response includes a `parent_folder` field with the parent Folder ID.

Use the `include_subfolders` query parameter to include a `folders` array in the response. Each entry is a complete Folder object with the same fields as the Folder you requested, including its own `folders` array, so the response contains the whole subfolder tree down to the Workspace's subfolder nesting limit. Subfolders the requesting user cannot access are excluded.

| Argument | In | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `folder_id` | path | number | yes |  |
| `include_subfolders` | query | boolean |  | Set to `true` to include the nested subfolder tree in the response as a `folders` array of complete Folder objects. Subfolder support must be enabled for the Workspace. (default `false`) |

### `get_folders`

**Get Folders** · `GET /api/v2/space/{space_id}/folder` · API v2 · 🟢 read-only

View the Folders in a Space. Subfolders are returned in the same flat list as top-level Folders, each with a `parent_folder` field holding the ID of the Folder it is nested inside of. This endpoint does not nest them; to get a Folder's subfolder tree, use [Get Folder](#get_folder) with `include_subfolders=true`.

| Argument | In | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `space_id` | path | number | yes |  |
| `archived` | query | boolean |  |  |

### `move_folder`

**Move Folder** · `PUT /api/v2/folder/{folder_id}/position` · API v2 · 🟡 write

Move a Folder, either by nesting it inside another Folder as a subfolder or by moving it to another Space as a top-level Folder.

Provide `parent_folder_id` to nest the Folder inside another Folder, or `space_id` to move it to another Space as a top-level Folder. If both are provided, `parent_folder_id` takes precedence and `space_id` is ignored, so the Folder inherits the Space of its new parent Folder. Use `position` to control placement among siblings in the destination; the Folder is placed at the top when `position` is omitted.

Nesting a Folder requires subfolder support to be enabled for the Workspace. Lists and tasks in the Folder move with it. To rename a Folder instead, use the [Update Folder](#update_folder) endpoint.

| Argument | In | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `folder_id` | path | number | yes |  |
| `body` | body | object | yes | JSON request body, fields below. |

<details>
<summary><code>body</code> fields (4)</summary>

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `parent_folder_id` | string |  | ID of the Folder to nest this Folder inside of, making it a subfolder. The destination Folder must be in the same Workspace. Subfolder support must be enabled for the Workspace. |
| `space_id` | string |  | ID of the Space to move this Folder to as a top-level Folder. Ignored when `parent_folder_id` is also provided, in which case the Folder inherits the Space of its new parent Folder. |
| `position` | integer |  | Position of the Folder among its siblings in the destination. Defaults to the top of the destination when omitted. |
| `custom_type_map` | object |  | Map of task type IDs in the Folder to the task type IDs to use after the move, as `{" ": }`. Required when moving to a destination where a task type used in the Folder is unavailable. |

</details>

### `update_folder`

**Update Folder** · `PUT /api/v2/folder/{folder_id}` · API v2 · 🟡 write

Rename a Folder. Renaming a subfolder leaves it nested inside its parent Folder, and the response includes the `parent_folder` field.

This endpoint only renames a Folder. To nest a Folder inside another Folder or move it to another Space, use the [Move Folder](#move_folder) endpoint; a `parent_folder_id` sent to this endpoint is ignored.
